proof_scope: Ordinary attachment identities and all legal tuning positions under the modeled catalog rules

recoil_path.input_assumption: No compensation or reaction; one fully reset uninterrupted firing string
recoil_path.chart_point_semantics: Cumulative source post-shot recoil; not validated bullet impact positions

metrics.window: first post-shot chart point to last post-shot chart point; first impulse reported separately

recoil_path.pre_shot_aim_proxy_note: Previous cumulative impulse before this shot, starting at zero. Consistent with lab hit-before-kick ordering; omits smoothing, spread, jitter and between-shot recovery. Not a measured impact simulation.
